frozen_scope.radial_method: Fraction exponent addition relative to one T4

required_certificates: T4*S0 has q=2, w=6 and H4 support
T4*I4 has H0/H8 but no H4
T4*I4^2 has q=4, w=8 and exact (3/4)H4+(1/4)H12
q=3 is impossible at all degrees within the declared generator semiring
degree-limited q=6 composite collisions are reported

acceptance_boundary.exact: parity, harmonic coefficients, exponent sums, and the declared-semiring q=3 no-go
acceptance_boundary.conditional: V4 parity and S0 existence/nonzero coupling
acceptance_boundary.excluded: data fitting, operator existence, new production scoring, and a continuum amplitude-ratio claim
